description: Add recovery message to I-CYCLOPS when CYCLOWRATH reaches zero from negative while preserving the predecessor's shared agitation-message branch.

replacements.new:
<COND (<L? ,CYCLOWRATH 0>
			      <SETG CYCLOWRATH <- ,CYCLOWRATH 1>>
			      <COND (<EQUAL? ,CYCLOWRATH 0>
			             <TELL "The cyclops finishes the last peppery mouthful, wipes his burning tongue with one forearm, and plants himself near the stair again. He is no longer hungry. He is very definitely thirsty." CR>)>)
			     (T
			      <SETG CYCLOWRATH <+ ,CYCLOWRATH 1>>)>
		       <COND (<NOT ,CYCLOPS-FLAG>
